candidate_terms.name: RoadSegment
candidate_terms.comment: A modeled portion of an urban road network.

candidate_terms.name: TrafficSensor
candidate_terms.comment: A device that observes traffic conditions.

candidate_terms.name: TrafficSignal
candidate_terms.comment: A signal device used to control traffic movement.

candidate_terms.name: AdaptiveSignal
candidate_terms.comment: A traffic signal whose operation can adapt to observed conditions.

candidate_terms.name: TrafficController
candidate_terms.comment: A control resource that operates traffic signals and regulates traffic.

candidate_terms.name: PublicTransitVehicle
candidate_terms.comment: A vehicle operating a public-transit service.

candidate_terms.name: TrafficIncident
candidate_terms.comment: A temporary event disrupting transportation operations.

candidate_terms.name: PerformanceMetric
candidate_terms.comment: A quantitative indicator used to evaluate transport performance.

candidate_terms.name: TransportAuthority
candidate_terms.comment: An organization responsible for transport governance and operations.

candidate_terms.name: SignalizedIntersection
candidate_terms.comment: An intersection represented as the location controlled by a signal.
